items.prompt: Why mark a BFS vertex discovered before appending it to the queue?

options.text: To stop several incoming edges from enqueueing it repeatedly
options.why: Its discovery state is already visible to later scanned edges.

options.text: To guarantee every weighted shortest path is solved
options.why: FIFO hop-distance reasoning is for unweighted/equal-weight edges.

options.text: To make every component connected to the source
To remove the need for all parent/distance state
options.why: Those outputs still need explicit state.

items.explanation: Discovery-on-enqueue gives one queue insertion per vertex and preserves the first-discovery parent/distance invariant.
